title: AISC benchmark Case 1 (P-delta only), US table, without shear deformation, P = 300

source.work: ANSI/AISC 360-22, Specification for Structural Steel Buildings (American Institute of Steel Construction), Commentary
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited page; nothing of the source is reproduced. Section properties of the W14x48 are not given by the source and are not taken from any table: I_x is calibrated on the source's own P = 0 deflection without shear deformation of Case 2, the shear flexibility on the source's P = 0 deflections with and without shear deformation (see build_problems.py and README.md)
source.location: Commentary Section C2.1, Fig. C-C2.2 (benchmark problem Case 1), US customary table, column P = 300, values in brackets

analysis: Case 1 of the source: simply supported beam-column (pin at the bottom, lateral roller at the loaded top) under a uniform transverse load of 0.200 kip/ft and the axial compression P; targets: moment and deflection at midspan. Axial load level P = 300 x 1 kip (load case P holds the unit axial load, the combination factor is the level). US customary table: E = 29,000 ksi, L = 28.0 ft = 336 in, I = 483.92 in^4 (calibrated, see source.notes), shear deformation excluded (the source's values in brackets). Member vertical along global Z, bending in the X-Z plane about local z (the section's Iz = Iy = I). Second-order analysis; the engine's member carries the exact stability functions, so one member is the exact solution of the second-order theory. The support idealisation is read from the source's sketch.

targets.precisionNote: stated tolerance 0.03 on printed "313"; acceptance criterion stated by the source on the same page (AISC 360-22 Commentary C2.1, p. 16.1-337): moments within 3 %, deflections within 5 %; value printed to 3 significant figures
targets.sign: magnitude in the source; in the engine's convention (member local x upward, local y = global +X, loads along +X) the midspan moment Mz of Case 1 is negative and the base moment of Case 2 positive

targets.precisionNote: stated tolerance 0.05 on printed "0.261"; acceptance criterion stated by the source on the same page (AISC 360-22 Commentary C2.1, p. 16.1-337): moments within 3 %, deflections within 5 %; value printed to 3 significant figures
targets.sign: magnitude in the source; the load acts along +X, deflection +X (local y)

limitsNote: Section properties are calibrated on the source's own P = 0 values (the source gives none): the problem verifies the second-order amplification, not section properties.
